g.title: MlQube: Management cluster and shared services
g.text: MlQube: Management cluster and shared services
3 · The platform's control plane · tenant workloads never run here

g.title: cluster_legend_frame
g.text: Terraform builds the foundation: VPCs, the three EKS clusters, RDS, base IAM; it bootstraps Argo CD
Argo CD (hub) syncs platform add-ons and configuration from Git to the management and workload clusters
A tenant or project is requested in Backstage; the template opens a PR with a Tenant / MLProject claim
Crossplane turns the claim into AWS and Kubernetes resources: S3 bucket, IAM role, ECR repo, namespaces, quotas
MLflow keeps metadata in RDS PostgreSQL and artifacts in S3 under a prefix per tenant
External Secrets copies secrets (e.g. the RDS password) from Secrets Manager into the clusters
All clusters send metrics, logs and traces to central observability; OpenCost reports cost per BU
